notes:
Opening the app is now fast on every launch — even when your network is slow.

**Fixes & polish**

- **Fast startup on every launch.** The app no longer waits on a network check before it opens. Previously, if the internet or DNS was slow, launch could sit for ~15 seconds on a blank screen before the window appeared; now the app opens immediately from its cached settings and refreshes them in the background. (Root-caused from startup logs; #611.)

**Under the hood**

- The remote-config fetch is moved **off the startup critical path**: the window opens from the on-disk cache instantly, and a fresh config is fetched on a background thread with a hard deadline that also bounds DNS resolution — so a slow or unreachable network can never delay launch. Remote kill-switch/flag changes now apply seconds after launch instead of only on the next launch. (#611; mirrors the launch-backup pattern, ADR-0020.)
- The dev-channel debug log level is now applied correctly, so the startup performance profiler's phase-by-phase timeline is actually captured in dev logs. (#611.)
